notes.title: Modifications to controller inputs
notes.content:
As a countermeasure when the controller input may not work
Improved default key placement for games.

If you could not enter it with the previous settings, you can install it again after uninstalling.
It will be updated to the corrected input settings.


* If the controller input still does not work
　Steam>setting>controller>『Controller Settings』
　Turn off all controller Steam Input enablements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284544/89a6a7a8ab4842b378eea6977ede5b7b920be1f1.png
*Because Steam's functionality interferes with the input originally provided by the PC,
　It works fine with it.
